proposals.evidence: The whole sleeping expression is the regional sut-/sot- verb developed from supta plus rah-/r- progressive. Turner explicitly gives Jaunsari sutṇu and the neighbouring sūt-/sut- verbs under supta; *rahati supplies the auxiliary and its ordinary endings.
